name: cover-roster-a
prompt:
Cinematic 16:9 video-game key art / Steam banner for a robot fighting game. Reference images 1-7 are OUR OWN original robot fighter designs; reproduce each one faithfully (same head shape, colors, armor panels, proportions). No other robots.

SCENE: inside a dark octagonal MMA cage at night: black chain-link fence panels with padded black posts, overhead lighting truss with hard white spotlights cutting through thick haze, a crowd in darkness beyond the fence, a white canvas mat under their feet with a red-and-blue circular center emblem (plain shapes, no lettering on it).

FOREGROUND LINEUP, full bodies, in confident fighting stances, a hero line-up shot from a low heroic camera angle, all four roughly the same size, standing on the mat, left to right:
- SAVATE (image 1): slim, elegant humanoid, matte plum-purple armor, faceted diamond-shaped purple chest plate, brushed-silver upper arms and thighs, off-white ribbed shin guards, a tall wedge-shaped plum head with a single thin vertical mint-green light strip, visible round bearing joints at shoulders, elbows and knees, fists up in a kickboxer guard.
- HAYMAKER (image 2): big heavy brawler, worn olive-green armor with bolts and scratches, huge rounded shoulder domes, a wide flat hammerhead-shaped head with two small red eyes, black cylindrical joint motors, wearing scuffed blue boxing gloves held high.
- FIRECRACKER (image 3): short compact stocky robot, glossy orange rounded body, red leather boxing headgear over a dark grey face with three round glowing lights (two eyes and one below), a small glowing yellow chevron on the chest, red boxing gloves, bouncing on its toes.
- PYLON (image 4): very tall lanky skinny robot, neon lime-yellow limbs alternating with black segments and thin silver bands, a narrow tilted lime head with purple glowing eyes and a thin antenna, long thin legs, one knee raised in a crane-style guard.

BACKGROUND: behind them, towering and larger, three NEXT GEN fighters loom as dark BACKLIT SILHOUETTES in the haze with only glowing eyes and sharp rim light revealing their outlines: PINWHEEL (image 5, sleek teal humanoid with copper trim and a cyan eye slit), JACKKNIFE (image 6, lean blue-and-cream robot with a long curved beak-shaped head and exposed spine), CAPSTAN (image 7, massive boxy maroon robot with big gear rings at the hips). Keep them mysterious, mostly shadow.

LIGHTING: dramatic rim light on every robot, volumetric god rays through haze, deep blacks, red light from the left and blue light from the right like fight corners, subtle sparks. All robots are electric: exposed electric servo motors, cables and bearings, NO hydraulic pistons. Photoreal 3D render, AAA game cinematic quality, sharp detail, no blood, no humans in the foreground.

TYPOGRAPHY (the only text in the entire image): at the top center, huge bold heavy condensed italic sporty title reading exactly "JEV KUNE DO" (three words: J-E-V, K-U-N-E, D-O), white metallic letters with a thin red and blue edge glow, very large and legible, occupying the upper third above the robots' heads. Directly below it, a much smaller clean tagline in spaced uppercase: "EVERY MOVE PICKED BY JEV". No other words, letters, numbers, logos, signage, watermarks or banners anywhere; the fence, mat and robots carry no writing.
